Testing Quarto!

```{r}

#load libraries
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)

#look at data
head(penguins)


```

This penguin dataset above summarizes three species of penguins and their body measurements across three islands

```{r}

penguins |> 
  mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)

# this doesn't work because of the tidyverse, need to use summarise or do:

mean(penguins$bill_depth_mm, na.rm=TRUE)

```


The average bill length is `r round(mean(penguins$bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))` millimeters. <- THIS WORKS
